_comment: Editable rules mapping Simmons Bank document titles to filename summaries, checked in order: tax, then insurance (unused), then statement. The category of each document comes from the documentType the page's own list names (statement, notice, tax), and simmons_site.summary_for names each file: '<date> Simmons Bank Loan Statement.pdf', '<date> Simmons Bank Notice - <title without its month and year>.pdf', '<date> Simmons Bank Tax Reporting <year>.pdf'. These rules say the same for the tools that read rules files.
